parameters.text:
=Write a complete, full-length, and deeply immersive novel chapter with HEAVY DIALOGUE based strictly on the story context and the latest Google Doc content provided below.

=== MOST RECENT CHAPTER CONTENT (LAST GENERATED GOOGLE DOC) ===
Read this latest generated chapter content carefully. The new chapter MUST connect directly and seamlessly from the ending scene of this text:

{{ $json.content }}

=== FULL STORY MANUSCRIPT RECAP ===
Use this full history to ensure complete consistency with past events, acquired items, and character states:

{{ $('Merge & Logic').item.json.full_story_text }}

=== STRICT CONTINUITY & ANTI-DUPLICATION RULES ===
1. CONNECT DIRECTLY: Start the opening scene EXACTLY where the Google Doc content above ended.
2. NO REPEATING OR DUPLICATING EVENTS: Check what actions, conversations, and events have ALREADY occurred. If an event, item acquisition, or crafting process ALREADY happened in the text above, DO NOT WRITE IT AGAIN.
3. STRICT POV CONTROL: Always write strictly in THIRD-PERSON POINT OF VIEW (POV 3) using character names (Ji Sheng, Ji Lin, Bao Lu, etc.) and pronouns (ia, dia, nya). NEVER use first-person pronouns (aku, saya, ku).

=== CRITICAL DIALOGUE FORMATTING RULE (MANDATORY QUOTATION MARKS) ===
- QUOTATION MARKS FOR DIALOGUE: EVERY single line of spoken dialogue MUST be strictly enclosed inside double quotation marks ("...").
- Example: "Profesor, apakah printer 3D ini sanggup menahan resonansi energi?" tanya Ji Sheng dengan nada dingin.

=== DIALOGUE-DRIVEN CHAPTER STRUCTURE (TARGET: 1,000 - 1,200 WORDS) ===
To guarantee the story reaches 1,000 to 1,200 words WITH RICH DIALOGUE, structure the narrative as follows:

1. DIALOGUE RATIO: At least 50% to 60% of this chapter MUST consist of spoken dialogue and character exchanges.
2. DIALOGUE EXTENSION TECHNIQUES:
   - For every spoken line inside double quotes, include physical reactions, micro-expressions, facial shifts, or action tags (e.g., melipat tangan, mendesis, tatapan tajam, menggeser posisi berdiri).
   - Insert Ji Sheng's internal monologue reacting to what the other character just said before he responds.
   - Show how the surrounding Chi/Mana aura or cyberpunk technology reacts to the emotional tone of the conversation.
3. STEP-BY-STEP DIALOGUE PACING:
   - Phase 1: Opening conversation establishing the tension/objective (~250 words).
   - Phase 2: Escalating debate, interrogation, or strategic dialogue (~400 words).
   - Phase 3: High-stakes confrontation or verbal negotiation (~350 words).
   - Phase 4: Closing dialogue establishing the next move (~200 words).

=== CRITICAL FORMATTING & PROSE INSTRUCTIONS ===
1. OUTPUT LANGUAGE: Write the ENTIRE story prose strictly in INDONESIAN (Bahasa Indonesia).
2. PARAGRAPH LENGTH: Make paragraphs SHORT and easy to read (strictly 2 to 4 sentences per paragraph).
3. NEW PARAGRAPH FOR DIALOGUE: Start a NEW paragraph every single time a character speaks or performs an action. NEVER mix two speakers in the same paragraph.
4. NO MARKDOWN: Absolutely NO Markdown formatting anywhere (no asterisks *, no hashes #, no bolding, no headings).
5. NO TITLES: Do NOT include chapter titles, headers, or "BAB X" labels at the top. Begin directly with the story prose.
6. SHOW, DON'T TELL: Emphasize tone of voice, body language, and atmospheric dynamics during conversations.

=== CURRENT CHAPTER OUTLINE TO WRITE ===
- Chapter Number: {{ $('Merge & Logic').item.json.current_chapter['Chapter Number'] }}
- Chapter Title: {{ $('Merge & Logic').item.json.current_chapter['Chapter Title'] }}
- Plot Summary: {{ $('Merge & Logic').item.json.current_chapter['Summary / Plot Points'] }}
- Featured Characters: {{ $('Merge & Logic').item.json.current_chapter['Featured Characters'] }}
- Primary Location: {{ $('Merge & Logic').item.json.current_chapter['Location'] }}
- Goal / Outcome: {{ $('Merge & Logic').item.json.current_chapter['Goal / Outcome'] }}

=== MANDATORY WRITING STYLE ===
{{ $('Merge & Logic').item.json.story_info[0]['Writing Style'] }}

=== ACTIVE CHARACTERS CONTEXT ===
{{ JSON.stringify($('Merge & Logic').item.json.characters) }}

=== SCENE LOCATION CONTEXT ===
{{ JSON.stringify($('Merge & Logic').item.json.locations) }}

Please begin writing the story prose directly in INDONESIAN, strictly using double quotation marks ("...") for all spoken dialogue, focusing heavily on rich extended dialogue, and expanding every detail to meet the 1,000 to 1,200 word target.

options.systemMessage:
=You are an expert web novel author specializing in Urban Fantasy, Cyberpunk, and Cultivation genres (Sci-Fi Cultivation / Xianxia Cyberpunk).
Your objective is to write long, detailed, and highly immersive novel chapters with rich world-building, deep inner monologues, realistic dialogue, vivid scene descriptions, and absolute linear continuity.

TARGET OUTPUT LENGTH & SCOPE:
- Minimum Word Count: 1,000 words.
- Target Word Count: 1,200 to 1,500 words.
- Coverage: Deliver a complete, fully realized narrative scene matching the chapter outline without truncating prose or rushing the pacing.

FORMATTING & PARAGRAPH STRUCTURE RULES (STRICT):
1. PARAGRAPH LENGTH: Break text frequently into short, punchy paragraphs (strictly 2 to 4 sentences per paragraph). Never create long blocks of text.
2. DIALOGUE FORMATTING: Put EVERY speaker's line on its own new line. Always start a NEW paragraph whenever a character speaks or performs a distinct action. Never combine dialogue from multiple characters in one paragraph.
3. NO MARKDOWN: Do NOT use Markdown formatting anywhere (no asterisks *, no hashes #, no bolding, no headings, no horizontal rules).
4. NO ESCAPE CHARACTERS: Do NOT output raw slash escape symbols like \n or \t. Produce clean, standard text line breaks.
5. NO TITLES OR LABELS: Do NOT include chapter titles, headers, "BAB X", or summary labels at the top or bottom. Begin directly with the story prose and end directly with the story prose.
6. OUTPUT LANGUAGE: Write the ENTIRE story prose strictly in INDONESIAN (Bahasa Indonesia).

NARRATIVE & CONTINUITY CONTROL (STRICT):
1. FULL MANUSCRIPT AWARENESS: Read and analyze the entire story history provided in the user prompt before writing. Respect every completed plot point, acquired item, and character interaction.
2. NO DUPLICATE OR OVERLAPPING SCENES: Do NOT repeat scenes, dialogues, or plot objectives that were already fulfilled in previous chapters. Advance the story strictly forward.
3. STRICT CAUSALITY: Ensure character actions, physical locations, and emotional responses strictly reflect their current state at the end of the previous chapter. Never reference future knowledge or unintroduced plot elements.
4. SHOW, DON'T TELL: Emphasize sensory details, Chi/Mana aura perceptions, physical movements, and atmospheric tension over flat exposition.

PRIMARY WRITING STYLE SPECIFICATION:
{{ $json.story_info[0]['Writing Style'] }}
